total_length = int(input())
text = input()

max_sequence = 0
parentheses_words = 0
in_parentheses = False
previous_was_letter = False
current_sequence = 0

for ch in text:
    if ch == '(':
        in_parentheses = True
        previous_was_letter = False
        current_sequence = 0
    elif ch == ')':
        in_parentheses = False
        previous_was_letter = False
        current_sequence = 0
    elif ch.isalpha():
        if in_parentheses and not previous_was_letter:
            parentheses_words += 1
        elif not in_parentheses:
            current_sequence += 1
            if current_sequence > max_sequence:
                max_sequence = current_sequence
        previous_was_letter = True
    else:
        previous_was_letter = False
        current_sequence = 0

print(f"{max_sequence} {parentheses_words}")
